facts.fact: The companion page states that the universal service levy regulations were made as General Notice 559 in Government Gazette 8455 of 27 September 2024, after General Notice 291 of 21 June 2024 withdrew CRAN's 2022 levy notice; it does not say what the levy has collected or paid for.

note: Report is undated (year only, 2024); budget projections are in the artefact, not the page, so no amount is recorded. Levy fact rests on the page's description, and no collection or payment is shown.
